title: ci: add Jenkins pipeline and parameterized server deployment
head: feature/jenkins-pipeline

reviews.body:
Single-owner COMMENT review by Kirti Vispute, assisted by Codex; this is not independent peer approval.

Reviewed Jenkinsfile/deploy-local.ps1: choice parameters validated before process replacement; Maven/JUnit gate precedes packaging/deploy; only the saved owned Java process may be replaced; unrelated occupied ports rejected; packaged and deployed hashes checked; local bind, persistent data outside Maven workspace, hidden launch, logs and readiness timeout present.

Verified [Jenkins build #2](http://localhost:8080/job/physio-portal-pipeline/2/) SUCCESS with 34 passing tests, deployment surviving build completion, health UP, two providers and matching archived/deployed SHA256 on 6af1dfdd4b49b7387a5f0ea426ac78c826e34460. The initial hung run and correcting commit remain documented. Reviewed PR head differs from that verified runtime only in documentation/evidence; no application/Jenkinsfile/deployment-script changes.

Local Windows built-in node and non-service demo process are stated in the guide. Final develop deployment uses nondefault test/8082. Selenium gate remains explicitly pending Tasks 9–10.
reviews.author: kirti-vispute
